method: Read-only audit of the -bolge family (READMEs + recorded evidence, session 2026-09-17/18). No binaries vendored: DATABASE.md declares external engines 'separate backends, not imports'. Every entry is a CLAIM until independently built and gate-executed per docs/EVIDENCE_MODEL.md (RUNNER_PROVENANCE).
canonical_gate: Hello, world. | 48 steps | a=19758 c=85 d=63 | HALTED | halt_reason=VInstruction (vm.c lineage: Malbolge-Engine/src/vm.c)

family_evidence.six_bolge_challenge: classic_challenge.mal -> 'Z', 7 steps, a=9856 c=6 d=40, identical across Swiftbolge, Rustbolge, Javolge, Cobolge, Fortranbolge, Wasmbolge (MALBOLGE/evidence/six_bolge_challenge.txt)
